item.title: sometimes i find music out there and think: "if it was me who had composed that, i would've deleted it and hated it", and these very songs are also, like, ridiculously popular. so now i can't even trust my own judgement on whether what i make is good or bad
item.description:
8.3.26 8:37 am
Q: sometimes i find music out there and think: "if it was me who had composed that, i would've deleted it and hated it", and these very songs are also, like, ridiculously popular. so now i can't even trust my own judgement on whether what i make is good or bad
A: if there's a popular song out there that you think sucks, you can be sure that plenty of other people also think it sucks. plenty of people think it's great also, for reasons you can't figure out, and yes this can feel kind of mysterious but it happens all the time. all the time. you've surely met someone who just likes the taste of some specific food that you simply hate the taste of, or the other way around. the important thing is to try to stick to cases where it aligns. because that also happens all the time. And here's what does not work: you trying to make something you don't like, based on the 'logic' that someone who doesn't like what you like will like what you don't like. that DOES NOT work. Imagine you are someone who can't tell the difference between blue and green, you only can see "yellow or not yellow", but you know that some people like blue and green pictures which you can't really even understand, but you wanna try doing it even though you cant see what youre doing, so you take a bunch of "not yellow" and mash it all together, it looks just as bad to you as those other blue-green pictures, but it also looks like shit to the blue-green seeers because you couldnt see what youre doing so you actually couldnt even make a picture of anything. in blue-green world, you are not detecting what is 'good/bad' about it. you are painting with colors you cant see. you must make things which you can detect. it's the only detector you actually have. and, as a creative expressor, your purpose in life, perhaps, is to express things in terms of how you currently see it
